text: This solution, Development Policy Financing with a Catastrophe Deferred Drawdown Option (Cat DDO) – Nepal, 2020–2025 addresses natural catastrophe in Nepal between Government of Nepal (Ministry of Finance and competent DRM agencies), World Bank, and Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR). The program was implemented in 2020 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
